narr: An upper trough rotating across the Rio Grande resulted in widespread shower and thunderstorm development across South Texas during the evening hours of May 18th and continued into May 19th. Redevelopment along a nearly stationary outflow boundary resulted in training of thunderstorms across portions of the Victoria Crossroads and Kleberg County. By the time the event ended, over 13 inches of rain had fallen at Kingsville with 8-10 inches of rain across Victoria and Port Lavaca. Flooding resulted in 50 homes being affected in Victoria County; 12 of those homes suffered minor damage. Over $15 million in damages to public property occurred across Victoria and Calhoun County from this event per the Texas Division of Emergency Management.
